sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK says Conficker is a worm that targeted Microsoft Windows using MS08-067 to spread.
MITRE ATT&CK says WannaCry contains worm-like features using SMBv1 EternalBlue to spread.

curator_note: Shared behavior only: both are Windows network worms exploiting major SMB/RPC-class vulnerabilities, not lineage.
confidence_reason: The broad behavior is source-backed; exact implementation differs.
